content.title: Chapter 58 - MUNICIPAL COURT — Sec. 58-132. - Procedure for expungement.

           …

faqs.a:
(a)
Upon the request of the defendant, the municipal court shall order the expungement
               of juvenile justice records pertaining to such person unless it determines that the
               police department or court has a substantial need for continued access to such records.
               If expungement is denied because of continued need for access, the court shall set
               a time when the defendant can reinstate the request for expungement.
(b)
The court may order the expungement of such records at any time after acquittal.
(c)
In the case of conviction, juvenile justice records shall not be expunged sooner than
               two years after the defendant's last conviction, excepting traffic violations. No
               records pertaining to a conviction shall be expunged during the pendency of another
               charge.
(Code 1981, § 2-222; Ord. No. 1905, § 2, 2-7-1983)
